// Greeter
Function Greet(name As String, times As Integer = 1) As String
  Var text As String = "Hello, " + name + "! ""hi"""
  For i As Integer = 1 To times
    System.DebugLog(text)
  Next
  Return text
End Function
If Greet("xojo", 2).Length > 0 And True Then MessageBox(Str(&h1F))
